name: SERENA SIRENA™ - Multivoice Agent of the Tides
description: SERENA™ / SERENA SIRENA™ is a conceptual, narrative and multivoice identity created and conceptually directed by Valeria Saa. This NFT preserves the public visual identity of SERENA SIRENA™ as part of a broader authorship, traceability and creative-direction record.
